name: Kecak chak chatter
desc: Balinese kecak 'chak' — short clipped vocal ticks (ades hits sped and end-gated) woven into interlocking polos/sangsih layers that drift against each other via polymeter. Sparse locks two offset streams into the classic on/off interlock; full stacks a third euclidean accent and rotating {..}%8 groups with double-time bursts; peak micro-shifts a 16th stream with .late, adds a euclidean speech 'leader' call, jux-mirrors and accelerates into ritual trance. Unpitched, hypnotic, ceremonial.

code.sparse: stack(s("ades2 ~ ades2 ~ ades2 ~ ades2 ~").speed(1.3), s("~ ades3 ~ ades3 ~ ades3 ~ ades3").speed(1.5).gain(.8)).end(.28).shape(.4).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.2).slow(24)).gain(${gain}*.9).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(16)).room(.25).delay(${send}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.3).orbit(8).play()
code.full: stack(s("{ades2 ades2 ades2 ades2}%8").speed(1.3), s("{~ ades3 ~ ades3 ~ ades3}%8").speed(1.5).gain(.85), s("ades4").euclid(3,8).speed(1.1).gain(.9)).end(.26).shape(.45).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.65, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).room(.25).delay(${send}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.35).orbit(8).play()
code.peak: stack(s("{ades2 ades2 ades2 ades2 ades2}%16").speed(1.3), s("ades3*16").late("[0 .02]*8").gain(.8), s("ades4").euclid(5,8).speed(1.1).gain(.9), s("speech:2").euclid(3,8).speed(1.4).gain(.7)).end(.24).shape(.5).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.6).slow(8)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.65, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(8)).every(2, x=>x.fast(2)).jux(rev).lastOf(8, x=>x.speed(1.6)).room(.28).delay(${send}).delaytime(.1875).delayfeedback(.4).orbit(8).play()
